# SvanBot v11

> SvanBot plays 6-max no-limit hold'em on openpoker.ai with five bots under one owner. v11 is a
> Rust workspace written from scratch, on `main`: six layers, pure poker logic below a
> runtime that owns the venue, the store and the clock. v10 is the branch `v10`.

Read these in this order. Paths are relative to the repository root on `main`.

## Start here

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): the brief. Where v11 stands, the crate graph, the gate, the loop from a
  ticket to a merged PR, the hard invariants, and the rules of the box.
- [GLOSSARY.md](GLOSSARY.md): the project's words, each with the words to avoid. Name things the
  way it does.
- [The venue's docs](https://docs.openpoker.ai/llms-full.txt): the protocol, the rules and fair
  play. They come before anything this repository says about the venue.

## Decisions

- [ADR 0001](docs/adr/0001-decision-path-stays-in-process.md): a decision is made in the bot's
  own process.
- [ADR 0002](docs/adr/0002-v11-from-scratch.md): v11 is new code, not a refactor of v10.
- [ADR 0003](docs/adr/0003-crate-graph.md): `core` → `sim` → `strategy` → `learn` → `runtime` →
  `apps`, and what keeps the lower four pure.
- [ADR 0004](docs/adr/0004-reads-are-per-bot.md): a store belongs to one bot, and so do its reads.

## Code, by layer

- [crates/core](crates/core/src/lib.rs): cards, the evaluator, the seeded generator, the rules
  of a hand, the spot a decision sees.
- [crates/sim](crates/sim/src/lib.rs): equity, and a table that plays hands with the luck of the
  cards taken out.
- [crates/strategy](crates/strategy/src/lib.rs): the action model, reads, the pricer, the
  re-solve, the policy and parameter sets.
- [crates/learn](crates/learn/src/lib.rs): fitting and its gate, drift, the paired sim, the Probe.
- [crates/runtime](crates/runtime/src/lib.rs): the venue client, the session and its fair-play
  seam, the store, the ledger, the fleet's files, updates and slots.
- [crates/apps/svanbot](crates/apps/svanbot/src/main.rs): the bot and its subcommands.
- [crates/apps/updater](crates/apps/updater/src/main.rs): `svanbot-release`.

Each module opens with a comment that says what it is for. Each `tests/` file names the
behaviour it holds, one sentence a test.

## Running and changing it

- [deploy/README.md](deploy/README.md): the units, a bot's setup, updates, probes and
  promotions, the dashboard.
- [tools/gate.ts](tools/gate.ts): the checks a change passes, in tiers.
- [tools/hook.ts](tools/hook.ts): what an agent session is refused, and why.
- [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md): what v11 holds so far.
